County and precinct figures for 7 contests (the Court of Appeals retention votes)
The workbook the Secretary's page links for these contests holds Shawnee County's statement of votes only, so only Shawnee's rows and the statewide figure are stored.

state
Write-in votes not given to a declared candidate
The Official Vote Totals print no write-in line, and only the sheets of Johnson and Shawnee carry one (3,615 votes in all), so no contest-wide figure exists and none is stored.
https://sos.ks.gov/elections/election-results.html
precinct
584 precinct figures printed 'Redacted'

The Shawnee sheets print 'Redacted' ('redacted per KSA 25-2701(a)(2)') where a precinct had so few voters that its figures could reveal how someone voted; those cells are not stored, and the county's Totals row, which includes them, is its county row.
https://sos.ks.gov/elections/election-results.html
race
Shawnee County: 'For County Commissioner 3rd District': two official figures

Write-in: the county's summary report prints 1,018, its statement of votes by precinct 1,015. The summary's own Total Votes Cast (23,673) agrees with the statement of votes, so the statement's figure is stored as the contest's; the summary's line is not used.
